pr_title: lib: os: onoff: Add cancellation before started feature
pr_body:
Extended onoff service to be capable of stopping service during starting.

Fixes #22974.

issue_context.title: Add cancel function to onoff service
comments: I see some possibility for this, but we need #22419 merged before I can start on it.

> This is very unusual

I have following case: USB plug in triggers HF clock request, plug out release. I have not control when those events come. They might be in the interrupt context so request is asynchronous.

Note that without that feature it is a step back in functionality for clock control as previously clock could be stopped at any moment and onoff without cancellation makes it very complex.
  
I've prepared #23087 with proposed solution.
I'll take a look at that PR.  Where is your current implementation using the API as it currently exists?
@nordic-krch Do you still need this, or has the subsequent rework of the onoff service satisfied your use cases?

review_comments: `-ECANCELED` is not error from the service but from cancellation. In that case, it can transition to off state as if successful stop would occur. If new requests came in the meanwhile it will behave the same way as if they came during stopping.

At this point, client is the last releaser, list is empty to accept new requests. transition to off is initiated. I'm not sure if `(state == SERVICE_STATE_TO_ON)`? If client is on the list, does it always mean that we are in volatile state (on to off or off to on)?
at this point successful cancellation is like stop but with specific error code.

Protection against case when `onoff_cancel` was called and transition to off initiated but before cancel function is called transition to on occurs. In that case, it shall be skipped because service will be cancelled and notification from cancellation will come to the user.
